comments.author: @BigGuy8059
comments.text: Bahasa Indonesia is what binds them all together.  Every island has their own local and tribal languages, but the genius thing is that everybody also speaks Bahasa Indonesia.  It began as a trade language, so different groups could communicate but it spread and standardized.  It is pretty much the simplest language in the world.  Understood even in Malaysia, the nearest mainland country.  No verb conjugations, not even any plurals.  For example instead of "mice" they just say their word for "mouse" twice.
